objective: Add a matrix repeater command that runs benchmark matrices repeatedly and emits stability plus trend reports.

tasks.title: Benchmark matrix repeater
expected_changes: Add bench_repeat.py to run fusiondb_matrix.py repeatedly.
Store repeated matrix outputs under one repeat run folder.
Automatically run bench_stability.py over repeated matrices.
Automatically run bench_trend.py between adjacent matrix pairs.
Update README with repeat workflow commands.
Verify with a tiny production repeat run.

verification_results.command: python -m py_compile bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_trend.py fusiondb_matrix.py fusiondb_bench.py external_smoke.py external_bootstrap.py
